instructions: Prepare the vegetables, aromatics, black beans, and sweet potato for black bean and tomatoes sweet potato hash.
Heat the cooking vessel and soften the aromatics until fragrant.
Add the seasoned black beans and cook it until browned or heated through as appropriate.
Stir in the sweet potato, vegetables, and sauce and cook until the mixture is tender and cohesive.
Taste the black bean and tomatoes sweet potato hash, adjust the seasoning, and portion it evenly while warm.
